_comment: How hard an inferno comes. Rates are against vanilla's own precipitation pass -- one position per
chunk every 48 ticks -- so 1.0 reach is 'as often as snow would have fallen there'.
Deliberately conservative on the first cut: too fast and a writer arrives at ash having never seen it
burn, which is the one calibration only a walk can settle. Harm is in half-hearts, and slow enough
that somebody who links in at noon has time to dig.
